bead.title: CL-001 Define dead/duplicative cleanup criteria
bead.description: Define objective criteria for what may be deleted or archived before the rename. Cleanup must be evidence-driven: no imports, no active docs references, no CLI path, no generated asset dependency, or explicit duplicate supersession.
bead.acceptance: A cleanup criteria doc exists under docs/research/ and includes delete/archive/keep criteria, required evidence types, and rollback expectations.
